headline: HoverAir’s transforming modular drone has already been halted in the US
summary: HoverAir Versa, a new modular drone, has been halted from US sales. The FCC's drone ban appears to have stopped orders just three days after its Indiegogo launch. Shipping to the US may also be abandoned.

headline: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle DOJ child privacy lawsuit
summary: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a US Department of Justice lawsuit. The suit alleged TikTok violated COPPA by collecting child data without consent. TikTok also failed to notify parents or delete accounts as required.

headline: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
summary: LinkedIn's "Seems like AI slop" button has been clicked over a million times. The feature was announced on July 30th to combat low-quality AI content. Users can access the button via the three-dots menu on posts.

headline: Apple is laying off staffers working on the Vision Pro and Siri
summary: Apple is reportedly laying off staff from its Vision Pro and Siri teams. Cuts include largely shutting down a Vision Pro gaming team. Over 200 jobs have been eliminated across these divisions.

headline: The Sinking City 2 Review
summary: The Sinking City 2 is described as an "off-brand Resident Evil." It's praised as a commendable imitation of its horror inspirations. The game is wrapped within the eerie Cthulhu mythos.

headline: Arc Raiders Players Torn After Embark Delays Future Expeditions Until Early 2027
summary: Embark Studios has delayed all future Arc Raiders Expeditions until early 2027. The delay aims to implement major improvements based on community feedback. Players are expressing mixed feelings and disappointment over the extended wait.

headline: Save $800 Off This Top-Tier iBuypower Gaming PC With AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D CPU and 5090 GPU
summary: Get $800 off a high-end iBuypower Gaming PC. It features an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D CPU and a 5090 GPU. The PC includes 32GB DDR5-6000MHz RAM, a 4TB SSD, and a 3-year warranty.

headline: Amazon Has Box Set Deals Hidden Deep Within Its BOGO 50% Off Book Sale
summary: Amazon's current BOGO 50% off book sale includes hidden deals on box sets. Shoppers can find significant savings on popular collections. This offers a chance to expand book libraries for less.

headline: Girl, 6, dies days after Shoreham sea tragedy killed three family members
summary: A six-year-old girl, Saja El-Khawas, has died after a sea tragedy in Shoreham. She is the fourth family member to perish in the incident off West Sussex. The family got into difficulty while in the water.

headline: Prince Harry and six others face privacy case legal bill of up to £34.5m
summary: Prince Harry and six other claimants face a legal bill up to £34.5 million. They must pay the Daily Mail publisher an initial £9.54 million within seven days. This follows their loss in a high-profile privacy case.

headline: More students planning to live at home for university over 'insane' living costs
summary: A growing number of students plan to live at home during university. This decision is driven by "insane" living costs, including rent and expenses. Students like Jessica worry about missing out on the full university experience.

headline: Russian double-tap drone strike kills 16 in Ukrainian mall, officials say
summary: A Russian double-tap drone strike reportedly killed 16 people in a Ukrainian shopping mall. The attack also injured at least 130 people, including 23 children. Officials reported the casualties after the mall was hit.
